sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "city"."County_ID" AS e, AVG((CAST("city"."Hispanic" AS REAL) / "city"."White")) AS m1, AVG((CAST(("city"."Asian" - "city"."Multiracial") AS REAL) / "city"."Multiracial")) AS m2 FROM "city" GROUP BY "city"."County_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m2" > "s2"."v") SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3"

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "city"."County_ID" AS e, "county_public_safety"."Location" AS g, AVG((CAST(("city"."Multiracial" - "city"."Amerindian") AS REAL) / "city"."Amerindian")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "city" JOIN "county_public_safety" ON "county_public_safety"."County_ID" = "city"."County_ID"  GROUP BY "city"."County_ID", "county_public_safety"."Location"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s1"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT AVG("s2"."m1") AS v FROM "s2") SELECT "s2"."g" AS g, "s2"."m1" AS m1, "s2"."m2" AS m2, ("s2"."m1" - "s3"."v") AS m3 FROM "s2" JOIN "s3" ON "s3"."v" IS NOT NULL
